notes.title: Hyposphere Update v.1.5
notes.notes:
- RETRO mode added in settings! (test version)
- Now you can center the camera with right stick / "C" button click
- Music changed on some levels
- Numeric value of FOV in settings (default: 105)
- VR-mode switch added in settings
- VSync switch added in settings
- 1366x768 resoultion added in settings
- "Continue" button fixed

notes.title: Hyposphere Update v.1.3.16
notes.notes:
- Now you got limited control of the camera (with mouse / right stick)
- Fallen blocks now restored correctly
- Now you could use left shift to enter "sneaking" mode and move slowly - use it for controls accuracy
- Restart button at the end of the level
- Now you could adjust FOV (field of view) in settings
- Main menu buttons / logos tweaks

notes.title: Hyposphere Update v.1.2.22
notes.notes:
- Improved perfomance
- New stats screen in the end of every level
- For every 50 points you’ll get 1 free life now

- Experimental support for HTC Vive controllers
- Sounds problems fixed
